item.title: My Bank Keeps On Undermining Anti-Phishing Education
item.description:
TLDR: my bank sent out emails with websites which looked a lot like phishing mails, so much so that this similarity could potentially be used against them legally by potential phishing victims

item.title: /now
item.description:
What is a /now page?

A /now page is about what someone is currently focused on and working toward. Think of it like what you’d say to a friend you haven’t seen in a year — a snapshot of what matters most right now.

Unlike social media updates or blog posts, a /now page focuses on the bigger picture rather than day-to-day highlights. It also contrasts with an /about page, which is more static and background-focused. If you want to learn more, check out nownownow.com/about.

item.title: About
item.description:
Who is this?

Take a generous scoop of tech enthusiasm, stir in a love for sports - especially running. Add a good pinch of curiosity for nearly everything. Mix well with lively debates, best served hot. Fold in some nerdy excitement and a splash of dry humor. Let it all simmer over a family background rich in wine. Grain in some CTFs. And there you have it: something that looks suspiciously like me.
